aiMetadata.description: Publishes a new question post (title, HTML content, optional comma-separated tags, optional locked flag) into a Bettermode community space identified by its space ID. Use to post a question thread programmatically; the post type is "Question" rather than a discussion. Not idempotent: each call publishes a separate post.

assign_badge.name: assign_badge
assign_badge.description: Assign an existing badge to a member by email

auth.description: Your domain should be the base URL of your Bettermode community. Example: community.example.com

region.description: The region of your Bettermode account

domain.description: The domain of your Bettermode account

email.description: Email address for your Bettermode account
The email of the member to assign the badge to

aiMetadata.description: Grants an existing Bettermode badge (by badge ID) to the member resolved from the given email address. The badge must already exist and the email must match a network member, or the call fails. Idempotent: the member ends up holding the badge regardless of how many times it is called.

revoke_badge.name: revoke_badge
revoke_badge.description: Revoke a badge from a member by email

auth.description: Your domain should be the base URL of your Bettermode community. Example: community.example.com

region.description: The region of your Bettermode account

domain.description: The domain of your Bettermode account

email.description: Email address for your Bettermode account
The email of the member to revoke the badge from

aiMetadata.description: Removes a Bettermode badge (by badge ID) from the member resolved from the given email address. The email must match a network member, or the call fails. Idempotent: the member ends up without the badge regardless of how many times it is called.
